input_arguments.name: quiet
input_arguments.description: Quiet mode (no progress bar or warning message)

input_arguments.name: overwrite
input_arguments.description: Whether overwriting existing output dataset is allowed

input_arguments.name: recursive
input_arguments.description: Travels the directory structure of the specified directories recursively

input_arguments.name: no-paths
input_arguments.description: Store just the name of a saved file, and do not store directory names

input_arguments.name: enable-sozip
input_arguments.description: Whether to automatically/systematically/never apply the SOZIP optimization

input_arguments.name: sozip-chunk-size
input_arguments.description: Chunk size for a seek-optimized file
input_arguments.metavar: value in bytes or with K/M suffix

input_arguments.name: sozip-min-file-size
input_arguments.description: Minimum file size to decide if a file should be seek-optimized
input_arguments.metavar: value in bytes or with K/M/G suffix

input_arguments.name: content-type
input_arguments.description: Store the Content-Type of the file being added.

output_arguments.name: output-string
output_arguments.description: Output string, in which the result is placed
